answer.text: Feel losses more acutely than equivalent gains (loss aversion)

explanation.text: The Logic: Prospect theory: loss hurts ~2× more than equivalent gain feels good. Drives risk-taking to avoid losses and risk-aversion for gains. The Trap: Equal weighting is the classical utility theory — prospect theory DEPARTS from it. Cross-Exam Context: Behavioural canon. Manager's Pro-Tip: Reframe portfolio drawdowns as 'dry powder for opportunity' — shifts client's loss-aversion frame.
